title: Durable transactional migrate agent for Private deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Private (VPC/on-prem) customers require bulletproof upgrades that can run across unreliable networks, mixed-version clusters, and air-gapped environments. Existing upgrade tooling relies on ad-hoc scripts + Helm hooks and leaves operators exposed to non-idempotent DB migrations and manual rollback steps. This ticket scopes a durable, transactional migration agent — a small, orchestrated runtime component that coordinates multi-step upgrades (schema, images, config) with explicit checkpoints, automatic rollback on safety violations, and observable progress for the Console and runbooks.

Goal: Deliver a migration agent and supporting control plane + CLI that enables:
- Transactional migration plans composed of idempotent steps with checkpointing and durable state persisted to the customer's control/native storage (etcd / Postgres within VPC)
- Preflight compatibility probes and dry-run mode that validate schema migrations and binary compatibility without applying changes
- Canary/rolling execution strategy with configurable batch size, soak times, and automatic rollback triggers tied to SLO/metric thresholds
- Safe, reversible schema migration patterns (versioned migrations, backfill orchestration, cutover window automation) and documented operator playbooks
- Integration points for Console rollouts (status, per-step logs, abort button) and telemetry events for migration observability

Scope (in this ticket): design + prototype + integration tests + Console status integration for the agent and a CLI to run migration plans. Production rollout and long-tail migrations will be follow-ups.

Non-Goals: managing host provisioning, hardware firmware updates, or adapting third-party DB engines beyond documented compatibility probes.
acceptance_criteria: Agent persists checkpoint state so a restart continues the plan without re-running successful steps
Dry-run mode validates schema changes and reports potential breaking operations without applying them
Canary execution completes on a 10-node testbed with configurable batch size and rollback on simulated error
Console displays per-step status and allows abort/force-continue with audit logs
E2E test demonstrates safe reversible cutover for a sample schema change with zero data loss on the test harness
Migration telemetry events sent to internal dashboards (start/step/complete/failure/rollback)
tasks: Write design doc: durable transaction model, checkpoints, lease/leader model for agent
Prototype agent binary with step engine and persistent checkpoint store
Implement preflight compatibility probes (schema linter, image runtime check)
Integrate agent with existing private control-plane storage APIs
Add Console APIs and UI hooks for per-plan visibility and abort/force actions
Create CLI wrapper for offline/on-prem operators to run migration plans
Create e2e test harness that simulates network partitions and agent restarts
Author runbook and operator playbook for common rollback scenarios
Add migration telemetry events and dashboard (migration success rate, median step time, rollback frequency)
risks: Long-running migrations may hold resources or locks leading to customer impact if not handled (need lease windows)
Non-idempotent migration steps could corrupt state if checkpointing is incomplete
Network partitions between agent and control-plane storage could cause split-brain without robust lease model
Incorrect automatic rollback criteria could cause oscillation (flip/flop) during noisy metrics
Air-gapped customers may not receive timely agent updates; need robust backwards-compatible plan format
